offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures school buses, including diesel, propane and electric models, and sells them to school districts and fleet operators through dealers and direct sales. It also supplies replacement parts for its buses.

primary_products.value: school buses; electric school buses; propane school buses; replacement parts

customer_segment.value: B2G: public school districts and government transportation agencies; B2B: private school operators, shuttle and commercial fleet operators

revenue_model.value: product sales: buses and replacement parts sold to school districts and fleet operators; service fees: maintenance, repair and training support for bus fleets

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds buses from purchased chassis and components, sold to school districts and dealers

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada, with some sales to other export markets

specialization.value: niche specialist: school buses and related parts

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent bus dealers that sell and service buses for school districts; direct sales: direct sales to large school districts and national fleet accounts

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: vehicle safety standards for school buses (FMVSS) and emissions rules (EPA, CARB)
